On Coruscant, Darth Vader waits for his Master to reveal his vision for the future. But is there a plan beyond obtaining power? On New Plympto, Jedi Master Dass Jennir leads a Nosaurian army in a war they have already lost. Is this what it now means to be a Jedi? '''''Star Wars: Dark Times''''' was a comic series published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. The first issue was scheduled for release in [[October]] [[2006]]. Similar to [[Star Wars: Rebellion (comic series)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']], it is a continuation of an older series, ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'', and continued the numbering of ''Republic'' on the inside. It also has the same miniseries style of ''Rebellion'', and ran in alternating arcs with it, and later the ''[[Star Wars: Invasion]]'' series.

The story begins shortly after [[Purge (comic book)|''Purge'']], and intertwines with the events of ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''. In [[July]] [[2008]], the line was paused for eight months to give precedence to the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Slaves of the Republic|''Clone Wars'' monthly comic]], resuming in [[April]] [[2009]]. In [[June]] [[2010]], it was put on hiatus once again, resuming in [[August]] [[2011]].
